children: FOXO Technologies' revenue rose 97.38% year over year, while earnings attributable to FOXO improved from a loss to income. Higher RCHI revenue, including Medicare cost-report adjustments, Medicare rate changes and increased swing-bed volume, drove the revenue gain; operating income improved with the higher revenue.
¹ Reported as “Net revenues”. ² Reported as “Net income (loss) attributable to FOXO”.
: Segment revenue rose 88%; higher RCHI revenue reflected Medicare cost-report adjustments, rate changes and increased swing-bed services.
: Vector generated $406,953 in revenue, compared with $31,630 a year earlier.
: The segment ceased research and development activities beginning in the quarter under the strategic technology license agreement.
: The proposed four-center purchase had not closed; required regulatory authorizations and financing remained outstanding.
